main_claim: Donchenko tells NV how little he earned early in his career, including 1,000-1,500 hryvnias per fight in a Kyiv restaurant club.
quote: Платили тисячу гривень за вихід і півтори — за перемогу.
note: His own account of his money and early life. The 5 September fight with Soriano is restated in the closing background lines, so it does not count.

main_claim: Topuria breaks his silence with a video letter to his son Hugo about the lesson of losing.
quote: Las primeras palabras de Ilia Topuria después de perder el cinturón ... han ido dirigidas a una persona en particular, Hugo, su hijo.
note: The guide says a post takes the value of what it says and a message to his son is personal_life; the injuries and the loss are recap.

main_claim: Reporter Alvaro Colmenero says Topuria will return to the public eye in September.
quote: I do know that Ilia is going to return to the public eye directly in the month of September.
note: A named journalist reports his return to public life. The Gaethje and Pimblett lines at the end are options and background, not a fight.

main_claim: Topuria publishes a written reflection on his first loss, listing the fractures he suffered and saying the defeat made him want to return more.
quote: both orbital bones fractured, my septum broken, and my foot broken
note: Follows the guide's essay example: he himself states his injuries inside the words the article is built on. An editor could call it no_fact, since the piece is mainly a reflection.

main_claim: Topuria's recovery is going well and he could be physically ready by the end of the year, though his conditioning coach expects a return in early 2027.
quote: Gallo reconoció además que la progresión deTopuria es positiva y que, si todo continúa como hasta ahora, podría alcanzar el nivel físico requerido para competir antes de que acabe 2026.
note: Named people (Dvalishvili, coach Gallo) say how he is and that the recovery is going well, which the guide makes health even when the headline is about the return date; status_update is the other reasonable reading. Possible opponents are named only as options.

main_claim: Topuria returns to social media with a video letter to his son Hugo about what the loss taught him.
quote: posted a video message framed as a letter to his son Hugo, reflecting on what he learned from the first defeat of his career
note: A message to his son is personal_life per the guide. The injury line, 'no timetable' and the rematch 'on the table' are the writer's background and options.

main_claim: Topuria's conditioning coach Jesús Gallo says his recovery has gone remarkably well and that he could be ready in December but should wait until 2027.
quote: Su preparador físico, Jesús Gallo, ha asegurado que "tiene un poder de recuperación increíble".
note: A named team member says how the recovery is going, so health beats the return-date framing. No specific fight is reported.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight and that either a Gaethje rematch or a Pimblett fight would suit the UFC.
quote: Topuria está listo para pelear, y nosotros estamos preparados para él. Ambas opciones [el combate contra Gaethje o el de Paddy] me parecen bien.
note: The promotion states he is ready and names opponents only as options, which the guide puts under status_update. The recovery line at the end is the writer's own recap.

main_claim: Topuria's favourite restaurant in Spain is Nou Collonet on the island of Tabarca, near Alicante.
quote: El lugar predilecto de Topuria para disfrutar de la gastronomía de nuestro país es el restaurante Nou Collonet
note: A lifestyle piece about his life outside the cage. Nobody named states it and it may not be new, so no_fact with firmness none is a fair alternative; I chose reported because the outlet asserts it itself.

main_claim: Conditioning coach Jesús Gallo says Topuria's recovery from his fractures has been excellent and he could be physically ready by December, though 2027 is the target.
quote: "La recuperación ha sido estupenda, y hay que darle un crédito increíble a los doctores que han estado trabajando con él en España.
note: A named team member updates how the recovery is going. Date and opponent are said to be unknown, so no next fight.

main_claim: Analyst Álvaro Colmenero reports that Topuria will return to public life within days, during September.
quote: sé que Ilia volverá a la luz pública. Todavía no sé exactamente cómo sucederá ni de qué manera será, pero sí sé que Ilia regresará a la luz pública durante este mes de septiembre.
note: A named reporter announces his return to public life. The loss and fractures are recap.

main_claim: Alexandre Pantoja sends Topuria a public message of support after his return to the public eye.
quote: "¡Todavía tenemos mucho por conquistar!", escribió el brasileño.
note: A message of encouragement carries no new fact. The Jon Anik rematch rumour sits in the closing paragraph as recalled background (the guide's Pantoja example), but it does name who said it, so an editor could read next_fight at rumour.

main_claim: Topuria publishes an essay reflecting on his loss to Gaethje, in which he lists his fractures and says the defeat made his fire bigger.
quote: Aquella noche conocí también una cara del deporte que nunca había experimentado: las dos órbitas de los ojos fracturadas, el tabique y el pie rotos.
note: Same case as the guide's essay example: his own statement of his injuries inside the main claim makes it health, official. no_fact is the alternative, since the essay is mostly reflection.

main_claim: Paddy Pimblett says he would love to fight Topuria next but that nobody has spoken to him about it.
quote: « Me encantaría destrozarle la cabeza, muchacho, pero tenemos que esperar y ver. Nadie me ha hablado de eso (una pelea con Ilia), así que veremos qué pasa»
note: The core is Pimblett's own wish with no talks, which the guide makes no_fact. But the article also says commentator Jon Anik asserts the Gaethje rematch will happen and that the fight is being talked about, so an editor could read a denied third-party rumour: next_fight at rumour, next fight yes.
